svg.title: From pixels to frequency coefficients
svg.desc: An 8 by 8 block of pixels is transformed by the 2-D DCT into 64 coefficients whose energy gathers near the top-left (low frequencies). Example DCT basis patterns are shown, and a two-level wavelet decomposition splits an image into LL, HL, LH and HH subbands.
svg.text: v: vertical frequency ↓ (stronger colour = larger, log scale)
6 largest of 63 AC terms hold 93% of the AC energy
the block is their weighted sum.
Each level splits LL again and
The inverse DCT returns the original 64 pixel values exactly; quantization, not the transform, is what loses information.
